TimOnPoint (@TimOnPoint) The Precision Arsenal Trap The United States' precision-strike model is not failing because precision weapons are ineffective; it is failing because American military strategy, defense industry, and political incentives have become organized around weapons that cannot be produced at wartime scale. Over the past three decades, the United States has built a military that excels at delivering precise, low-risk, stand-off effects. Cruise missiles, stealth aircraft, precision-guided bombs, and sophisticated targeting networks can rapidly dismantle an opponent's command structure, air defenses, logistics nodes, and other high-value targets. These capabilities remain among the most formidable military advantages ever developed. Their weakness is not effectiveness. It is scale. Modern precision weapons are expensive, technologically complex, and produced at comparatively low rates. Against a capable adversary possessing large inventories, dispersed infrastructure, and an enduring industrial base, the United States can expend years of production in weeks of combat. The opening campaign may achieve remarkable tactical success, yet every launch steadily reduces a finite magazine that cannot be replenished at the rate it is consumed. This is not simply a munitions problem. It is a structural feature of the new American way of war. The United States has optimized for the first 30 days of a major war more successfully than it has optimized for day 300. Following the Cold War, precision strike became increasingly attractive because it minimized collateral damage, reduced risk to American personnel, satisfied increasingly restrictive legal and political expectations, and enabled limited military interventions without large-scale ground commitments. Operational success reinforced this model. Investment flowed toward increasingly sophisticated precision systems while comparatively little attention was paid to sustaining the industrial capacity necessary for prolonged, high-intensity conflict. At the same time, the defense industrial base underwent profound consolidation. The post-Cold War "Last Supper" reduced dozens of major defense firms to a small number of dominant prime contractors. Munitions production consolidated even further. As competition declined, these firms acquired substantial influence not only over production but over the definition of military requirements themselves. Requirements increasingly favored technologically exquisite, highly integrated systems that only a handful of incumbent contractors could realistically deliver. This influence extended beyond engineering. Long-established (sometimes questionable) relationships among Congress, the Department of War, prime contractors, defense consultancies, and the revolving door connecting senior military leaders, acquisition officials, industry executives, and lobbyists created a powerful institutional preference for continuity. Individual participants may (or may not) have acted in good faith, yet the system consistently rewarded familiar suppliers, established acquisition pathways, and incremental modernization over disruptive changes in production, procurement, or force design. The result was a self-reinforcing cycle. The acquisition system generated requirements for increasingly sophisticated weapons. Those requirements favored incumbent firms possessing the necessary intellectual property, manufacturing expertise, and political relationships. The resulting systems were exceptionally capable but expensive and produced in relatively small numbers. Military doctrine then evolved around the assumption that these weapons would remain available, reinforcing demand for the next generation of similarly exquisite systems. The consequence is visible whenever the United States confronts a marginally capable industrial opponent. Precision strike delivers devastating effects during the opening phase of a campaign, but its effectiveness declines as inventories shrink faster than production can replace them. The constraint is no longer tactical performance; it is industrial throughput. The consequence is not merely a shortage of missiles. It is a force structure increasingly dependent on single points of industrial failure. Every exclusive production line, proprietary interface, or single-source spare part becomes a potential strategic bottleneck during a prolonged war. This limitation becomes especially apparent when military objectives require persistent physical control rather than destruction alone. Precision weapons destroy targets. They rarely occupy terrain, deny access indefinitely, inspect facilities, or prevent an adversary from regenerating combat power. States possessing dispersed missile forces, hardened infrastructure, underground production, or resilient industrial networks can recover from repeated strikes so long as they retain physical control of their territory. Precision can suppress regeneration; it cannot permanently replace ground control. Political realities deepen this dilemma. Large-scale ground operations carry significant domestic political costs measured in casualties, duration, financial expense, and escalation risk. Yet ground forces exist precisely to perform the missions that stand-off precision cannot complete: seizing terrain, denying access, enforcing control, and preventing regeneration. The United States therefore finds itself caught between two politically preferred but strategically incomplete options: finite precision campaigns and the avoidance of large ground commitments. 1/2 — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/TimOnPoint/status/2085036585817362470#m

I expressed my gratitude for Japan’s unwavering support for Ukraine’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, as well as for the substantial practical assistance provided, in particular, to Ukraine’s energy sector. Through the Ministry of Energy’s hubs alone, Ukraine has received more than 113 tonnes of humanitarian aid, including 259 backup power units. Our partners provided assistance under various support programmes, including two gas turbines and mobile substations, 181 generators, 118 transformers, 6,400 gabions, and other essential equipment. We look forward to continued cooperation as Ukraine prepares for the 2026/2027 heating season, as russia continues its targeted attacks on our energy and gas infrastructure. We discussed the need to accelerate the procurement, with JICA’s @JICA_direct_en support, of 62 power transformers for frontline regions. One such transformer has already been delivered to the Kherson region, with another 27 supplied to the Mykolaiv region. Together with our Japanese partners, we are also working on procuring specialised equipment for gas production. We are equally interested in exploring opportunities for cooperation on the restoration and modernisation of Ukraine’s thermal power plants (TPPs) and combined heat and power plants (CHPs) during 2027-2030. We deeply value Japan’s support and our partners’ readiness to continue our cooperation in strengthening Ukraine’s energy resilience. Russia's rate of advance towards Dobropillia and Druzhkivka has increased in recent weeks. Small Russian infiltration groups from the 177th Naval Infantry Regiment have reached the southeastern part of Dobropillia, and other groups have made it north and northeast of Hannivka on the T0514 road moving from Novyi Donbas. Russia's 9th Motorized Rifle Brigade and 61st Naval Infantry Brigade are attempting to encircle Dobropillia from from the east/northeast using the high ground (including a height south of Stepy), while the 177th is approaching Dobropillia from the east along the T0515 road. Russian forces have reached the mine east of Chernihivka, which will serve as a hub for UAV crews (terricons provide valuable high ground for antenna) and infiltration groups. Russian presence in Bilytske (from the 5th Motorized Rifle Brigade), Chernihivka, and Matyasheve is increasing. To the east, Russia has advanced in Kucheriv Yar and Torske, placing its forces less than 9km from Druzhkivka. This is in part due to the reinforcement of this direction with the 90th Tank Division's 228th and 239th regiments (they took part in the July 22nd mechanized assault), which indicates it is a priority. Further Russian advances in this direction will pose a greater threat to Druzhkiva from the south/southwest, and Dobropillia from the east/northeast. Taking more high ground will also enable Russia to threaten Ukrainian logistics in both directions. In particular, Russian forces could put the Oleksandrivka-Kramatorsk portion of the T0510 road under fire control, which would complicate Ukrainian logistics. Russian forces are employing 15 inch fiber optic cable FPVs in this direction with a range of 50km with strikes in Novodonetske. Although Ukraine's middle strike campaign has raised the costs for Russia and complicated their logistics, Russia still has rough parity in FPVs in this direction and continues to receive sufficient artillery ammunition (the greater problem is the diversity of ammunition sources). The situation east of Kramatorsk and Slovyansk is also becoming more difficult (Russia's Southern Group of Forces was responsible for approximately half of Russia's gains in July), which will force Ukraine into a difficult choice where to commit reinforcements. Serving as the White House Press Secretary over the past year and a half has been the honor and adventure of a lifetime. I am incredibly grateful to President Trump for granting me so many extraordinary opportunities, such as working in the West Wing and spending countless hours in the Oval Office, flying around the world and meeting foreign leaders, and traveling across our beautiful country and meeting Americans from all walks of life. Most of all, I am thankful to the President for entrusting me with the distinct privilege of speaking on his behalf at the White House podium. I have spoken with great pride about the many historic accomplishments of this Administration, and I have relished holding the liberal media accountable and ensuring the American people hear the truth about President Trump’s successes. Being a mother and welcoming a new baby while working in one of the most demanding jobs in the world has been the most rewarding yet challenging season of my life, to say the least. Kenya has made tremendous strides in many sectors under Vision 2030, launched in 2008 by President Mwai Kibaki. Across the country, we have witnessed the transformation of our infrastructure and the delivery of landmark projects, including the Lamu Port, the Isiolo-Moyale road, and the Nairobi Expressway, among others. These achievements have expanded opportunity, strengthened connectivity and laid a strong foundation for our nation’s future. As Vision 2030 approaches the end of its course, we gathered at Nairobi's Kenyatta International Convention Centre to begin an important national conversation: What comes next? This is not simply a question about another plan or another set of targets. It is an invitation to imagine, together, the Kenya we want to become not only in the next decade, but also deep into the future. Soykırımcı Netanyahu hükûmeti, tüm dünyanın gözü önünde Batı Şeria ve Kudüs’teki hukuk dışı tasarruflarını sürdürüyor. İşgal, zorla göç ettirme ve gasp politikası maalesef artarak devam ediyor. Birleşmiş Milletler verilerine göre sadece 2026 yılında yerleşimci terörü, yıkımlar ve tahliyeler nedeniyle yaklaşık 3.800 Filistinli yerinden edildi, 100’e yakın Filistinli kardeşimiz katledildi. Bu durum, sistematik bir işgalin ve Filistin yönetimini kendi topraklarında nefes alamaz hale getirmeye çalışan bir yıpratma stratejisinin ürünüdür. Ama tüm sindirme ve tehcir teşebbüslerine rağmen Filistin halkı dimdik ayaktadır. Bu tablo karşısında Sayın Abbas’la görüşmemizde yapılabilecekleri değerlendirdik. Gazze’de yeniden imar ve inşa sürecinin başlatılması ve güvenliğin temini için gerekli koşullar bir an önce sağlanmalıdır. Uzun bir süreden sonra Filistin’de gerçekleştirilmesi öngörülen yasama ve başkanlık seçimleri kararının hayırlara vesile olmasını diliyoruz. Some maps help you find your way. Others help you see the world differently. 🗺️🎨 Our 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) captures the shape of the land through high-resolution elevation data. Through our 3DEP as Art series, we transform these scientific datasets into visual representations of elevation, revealing the ridges, valleys, and slopes that shape the terrain. Created from bare-earth elevation data, these maps remove vegetation and structures to showcase the underlying terrain in a new way. This data supports a wide range of applications, including mapping, natural resource management, hazard assessment, scientific research, and informed decision-making. Google has quietly stopped searching by Exact Phrase when you use quotes. Now by default Google will return pages and pages of results you don't want. Google now thinks you use quotation marks for no reason even though quotes have specifically been the correct format for exact phrase searches on Google. Maddenly, even using the Advanced Search page and the "This exact word or phrase" text box no longer searches by exact phrase. I was trying to see if the air purifier company IQAir ever mentioned a key air filtration term on their website. So I typed in an exact phrase search for just the IQAir website: " "most penetrating particle size" site:iqair.com/ " What I got was 6 useless pages of links to pages that do not contain the exact phrase "most penetrating particle size," but instead contain some or all of the words. That's the result I should get when I don't use quotation marks. You can fix this behavior on a search results page by going to the "Tools" drop down menu and changing the "All results" setting to "Verbatim". There is no way to set Verbatim as the default for future searches AFAIK.

Le sorgenti dell'Apartheid🧵 Cisgiordania. Le sorgenti di Nabi Aner sono di proprietà privata di una famiglia palestinese, sono aperte a tutti, chiunque può sostare o fare un bagno, gli agricoltori utilizzano l'acqua per irrigare i campi. È stato sempre così, fino al 2014, quando un gruppo di coloni assalta e occupa le sorgenti, arrivano i militari che delimitano il sito e vietano l'accesso ai proprietari e agli agricoltori costretti ad abbandonare i terreni oramai inariditi. Il sito è diventato un parco per turisti israeliani. Secondo i dati ONU, negli ultimi 15 anni i coloni hanno occupato oltre 50 fonti d'acqua nella Cisgiordania centrale, tutte di proprietà palestinese, quasi tutte acquisite illegalmente dallo Stato occupante, rinominate e usate per scopi turistici ad uso esclusivo degli israeliani. L'apoteosi dell'illegalità. Nel 2019, il celebre giornalista israeliano Gideon Levy volle visitare alcuni siti occupati, nacque un reportage straordinario. Scrisse Gideon Levy "In queste sorgenti di Anar Springs, sorgenti di Apartheid, dalle finestre delle loro case, i proprietari palestinesi possono solo guardare con disperazione i loro antichi uliveti trascurati. Gli alberi sono uno spettacolo pietoso, sembrano chiedere aiuto" "Molte di queste sorgenti rubate sono deserte, i visitatori sono rari, i terreni intorno sono incolti e abbandonati, mucchi di immondizia si accumulano senza pietà" All'ingresso della sorgente di Anar Springs c'è un cartello che è la rappresentazione plastica di una società che non conosce il senso della vergogna "Cari escursionisti, benvenuti ad Anar Springs costruita grazie a un intenso lavoro dei giovani di Nira [*i giovani di Nira sono i coloni dell'avamposto illegale che hanno occupato il sito] Abbiamo costruito il sito per il tuo bene e per il bene del popolo di Israele. Il nostro obiettivo è che TUTTI possano fare escursioni e godere insieme delle sorgenti" Gideon Levy chiede a un militare di guardia al sito: "Possono entrare tutti? A qualcuno è vietato entrare qui?" "È vietato agli arabi" risponde il militare. Un altro soldato interviene per precisare: "Questo posto è riservato solo agli ebrei".

وزارت امور خارجه ایالات متحده اعلام کرده است که برای مقابله با روش‌های سازمان‌یافتۀ "گردشگری تولد" که از قوانین ویزۀ ایالات متحده سواستفاده می‌کنند، اقدامات جدی را آغاز کرده است. مارکو روبیو، وزیر خارجۀ ایالات متحده در پیامی در شبکۀ ایکس نگاشته است: "شهروندی امریکا برای فروش نیست." شهروندان کشورهای دیگر با استفاده از این روش برای به دنیا آوردن فرزند به امریکا می آیند، تا کودکان آنان بتوانند تابعیت امریکا را به دست آورند. گروه ویژۀ کاری پیشگیری از گردشگری تولد در وزارت امور خارجۀ امریکا، فعالیت‌های مربوط به ویزه را بررسی کرده، شبکه‌های غیرقانونی را هدف قرار داده و اتهامات مربوط به تقلب، از جمله جعل اسناد و ارایه درخواست‌های گمراه‌کننده برای ویزه را بررسی می‌کند. بر اساس اعلامیۀ وزارت امور خارجۀ امریکا، این گروه ویژه کاری در نخستین ماه فعالیت خود بیش از ۶۰۰ ویزه را لغو کرده است. مقام‌ها می‌گویند که این اقدامات به‌عنوان بخشی از تلاش گسترده‌تر برای متلاشی کردن شبکه‌های گردشگری تولد و حفاظت از یکپارچگی قوانین مهاجرت و تابعیت امریکا ادامه خواهد یافت. دونالد ترمپ، رییس‌جمهور ایالات، در ششم اگست دو فرمان اجرایی درباره تابعیت بر اساس تولد و جلوگیری از "گردشگری تولد" صادر کرد. هدف این فرمان‌ها محدود کردن تابعیت در برخی موارد و جلوگیری از سفر افرادی است که به‌منظور تولد فرزند و دریافت تابعیت امریکا برای نوزاد شان وارد این کشور می‌شوند. قصر سفید می‌گوید که این اقدامات بر قوانین مهاجرتی و صلاحیت‌های اجرایی موجود استوار است. با این حال، تلاش قبلی رییس جمهور ترمپ برای تغییر قانون تابعیت بر اساس تولد با مخالفت محکمه عالی امریکا روبه‌رو شده بود. wxyz.page/LK52k

At the Permanent Council session to commemorate the International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples, within the framework of the Ninth Inter-American Week, I emphasized something fundamental: we must genuinely listen to Indigenous elders and peoples. Their knowledge and their ways of governing through consensus are not relics; they are urgent solutions. Yet, the @CIDH and the Inter-American Court @CorteIDH have documented with painful clarity the discrimination, exclusion, and violence they continue to face—a burden disproportionately borne by Indigenous women. The American Declaration is our hemisphere's most significant response, but good intentions without political will and resources are not enough. Indigenous rights must no longer be a matter for negotiation, but a living reality. Our obligation is to stand firmly beside them. #OASIndigenousWeek #WeAreIndigenous Video

A CUÁNTO LLEGARÁN EL DÓLAR Y LA INFLACIÓN A FINES DE 2027: LOS DOS ESCENARIOS QUE PROYECTÓ UNA CALIFICADORA DE RIESGO Las proyecciones para el futuro inmediato de la economía argentina surgen de un informe de FixScr, filial local de una de las agencias globales más relevantes. Incluyen estimaciones de dólar, inflación, actividad, saldo comercial y tasa de interés en base a un presupuesto optimista y otro pesimista. La evolución del dólar, la inflación y otras variables clave durante los próximos fue el foco de un reciente informe de FixScr, la filial en Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay del gigante mundial de la calificación de riesgo, Fitch Ratings. El estudio anticipa dos trayectorias posibles para las principales variables macroeconómicas, diferenciando un escenario base, considerado de mayor probabilidad, de uno alternativo, de tono más pesimista y menor posibilidad de ocurrencia. En base al desempeño del programa de Javier Milei, el primer escenario contempla un dólar de $2.047 para fines de 2027 si todo sale bien. En caso de que la recuperación sea más dura, en cambio, esa variable terminaría 2027 a $2.246 por unidad. Infobae 📎 infob.ae/4x2Auh6

A delegation led by Minister of Energy of the Republic of Belarus H.E. Dzenis Maroz called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad on 12 August 2026.

ISLAMABAD: 12 August 2026. H.E. Mr. Dzenis Maroz, Minister for Energy of the Republic of Belarus, who is currently on an official visit to Pakistan, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House, this afternoon. While welcoming the Belarusian Minister and his delegation, the Prime Minister conveyed his warm greetings and good wishes for President Alexander Lukashenko. He fondly recalled President Lukashenko’s visit to Islamabad in November 2024, as well as his own visit to Belarus in April 2025, that further strengthened bilateral ties across all spheres of shared interest. The Prime Minister expressed satisfaction over the productive deliberations held during the 9th Session of the Joint Ministerial Commission (JMC) held in Islamabad, wherein the two sides reviewed the entire spectrum of bilateral cooperation, including in trade, industry, agriculture, banking, labour, transport, and energy sectors. Both sides expressed confidence that the outcomes of the JMC would translate into tangible benefits for both countries and further consolidate the growing partnership between Pakistan and Belarus. The visiting Minister thanked the Prime Minister for the gracious welcome, and conveyed the warm regards of the Belarusian leadership. He briefed the Prime Minister on the substantive progress made during the JMC meeting. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to further deepen bilateral coordination to materialize cooperation across all sectors agreed between the leadership of two countries. Video

The discussions highlighted the importance of sustained R&D, pilot projects and an enabling policy and regulatory framework to build confidence for large-scale deployment. Developing a credible pathway from estimated potential to proven storage capacity will be critical for unlocking the role of geological carbon storage in India’s energy transition. #CCUS #CarbonStorage

The roundtable focused on the potential of geological storage as a key component of India’s Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage (CCUS) strategy. India has significant geological potential for storing CO₂, including in deep saline aquifers and basalt formations. The key challenge is to translate this potential into safe, reliable and cost-effective storage solutions through a source-to-sink approach supported by field evidence and demonstration projects.

Young people are on average the healthiest part of society, but are at particular risk of health threats including mental health conditions, loneliness, violence and road traffic crashes. Addressing their health needs is essential to achieving health for all. Over the past nine years, WHO has made a concerted effort to include the voices and ideas of young people in our work, as part of the WHO Transformation. We recognize young people not just as beneficiaries of our work, but as critical partners in achieving global health goals. That’s why in 2023 we launched the @WHOYouthCouncil, a network to advise WHO and ensure that youth voices are not only heard but are instrumental in influencing policy and actions. Through the Youth Council, WHO aims to co-create solutions that are youth-led, youth-driven, and tailored to their specific health needs. "Earlier this week, the government of the United States announced a significant change in its policy for childhood vaccination. Every parent wants to keep their children safe, and vaccines are among the most powerful tools for doing that. WHO is concerned that the changes to immunization policy in the U.S. are not aligned with the best science. Decades of evidence have shown when children are most vulnerable to disease, when vaccines provide the strongest protection, how many doses are needed, and which vaccines can safely be given together. That evidence is reviewed continuously as new data emerge from across the globe. And the current evidence is unequivocal: vaccines – including the MMR vaccine – are safe and do not cause autism. Delaying vaccines or separating doses unnecessarily does not make vaccination safer, and can leave children unprotected. Vaccination policy should be guided by rigorous, independent and transparent review of the best available science, and not by political influence"-@DrTedros

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested one accused in connection with the attack involving an improvised explosive device at a residential house in Tronglaobi Awang Leikai, Moirang, Bishnupur District, Manipur. The incident occurred on 7th April 2026 and resulted in the death of two minor children and injuries to another person. The case (RC-04/2026/NIA/IMP) was originally registered at Moirang Police Station following an attack where unknown militants launched an explosive device from a hillside towards Tronglaobi Awang Leikai. The explosion struck the residential wall of a house, causing serious injuries to three family members, including two minor children who later succumbed to their injuries. An unexploded improvised RPG was also recovered near the site.

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) conducted a search operation at 13 locations, eight in Tamil Nadu and five in Mizoram, in connection with the seizure of 6016.87 kg of Methamphetamine from a Myanmarese boat near the Barren Islands in the Bay of Bengal in November 2024. Several digital devices were seized during the coordinated operation by NIA teams for further forensic analysis to uncover the complete network involved. Al doctor García no le gustará lo que voy a decir pero como ex voluntaria de la Cruz Roja debo refutarlo. Hago un hilo para ello: 🧵 🇨🇴soyDrGarcia (@SoyDrGarcia) Me van a dar duro por lo que voy a decir pero como exvoluntario de Cruz Roja Colombiana y médico de atencion prehospitalaria explico el porque Colombia en este momento no necesita más equipos de rescate de los que ya hay. Primero debo decirles que Colombia cuenta con 23 equipos de rescate conocidos como USAR (Urban Search and Rescue) con cerca de 1000 rescatistas y de esos 1000 hay 170 que hacen parte del equipo elite conocido como el USAR COL-1 que cuentan con alta acreditación internacional, esto hace que el país sea uno de los 4 países en todo el continente americano y el único en la región que tienen un equipo de búsqueda y rescate certificado por la ONU. Segundo, aparte de los socorristas, Colombia cuenta con 18.000 voluntarios activos de Cruz Roja y alrededor de 45.000 de la defensa civil en todo el país, además de los cuerpos de bomberos y personal del ejército, lo que hace que solo el cuerpo de voluntarios y socorristas sean de alrededor de unos 65000 sin contar con las demás instituciones, claro no todos se van a activar pero se puede disponer de ese personal en el caso que se requiera. Tercero, después de una tragedia las 72 horas posterior al evento son primordiales y la mayoría de las personas que son rescatadas lo son por los equipos de rescate locales y por los familiares, amigos, vecinos, etc, que ayudan en las labores de rescate, los equipos internacionales generalmente llegan luego de estas 72 horas y no hay evidencia que respalde que a más grupos de rescate hayan en una zona más posibilidades haya de encontrar más sobrevivientes. Cuarto, porque al haber muchos grupos de rescate no se genera una buena coordinación entre equipos, se descuidan zonas y en una zona donde hay escasez de alimentos se vuelve un problema el brindar alimentos tanto a ellos como a los pobladores y supervivientes. Quinto, no todos los equipos de rescate enviados están bien certificados para la labor y esto es fundamental porque un equipo de rescate certificado sabe en donde y como actuar, reduciendo la improvisación y disminuyendo el riesgo. Es por eso que en este momento no se necesitan más equipos de rescate sino que se necesitan más insumos y donaciones. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/SoyDrGarcia/status/2087457969185206372#m

Speaking to reporters yesterday night, President Donald J. Trump seemingly confirmed reports that he was secretly moved off Air Force One and onto a military plane while returning from the NATO Summit last month in Turkey. Asked why the situation was dangerous enough for him to be transferred to another aircraft but members of his Cabinet, senior officials, and reporters were left on Air Force One, Trump responded: “Well, I don't know. I think actually the plane that I flew on was at greater risk... Because that would be the plane I think that they would be more likely to go for.” Video
Source: nytimes.com/2026/08/11/us/po…

New reporting sheds more light on why Trump was secretly removed from Air Force One in Ankara last month. U.S. intelligence reportedly picked up multiple streams of information indicating a specific surface to air missile threat against the aircraft carrying Trump. Someone near the NATO summit was also reportedly observed with a shoulder-fired missile. Even more concerning is that U.S. officials say Iranian intelligence knew where Trump was staying in Ankara, including the floor of the building. The threat was considered credible enough to trigger an extraordinary deception. Trump publicly boarded the legacy VC-25A 'Air Force One', was secretly removed in a catering container, and departed Turkey aboard a C-32A. The VC-25A then flew on with senior officials, staff and reporters aboard, creating the appearance that Trump was still onboard. There is no public evidence Iran actually attempted to attack the aircraft. But the combination of a potential missile threat and highly specific knowledge of Trump's location was apparently serious enough for the U.S. to treat the threat as real. The biggest unanswered question may be how Iran obtained such detailed information about the president's movements and lodging.

🚨 BREAKING: Israel detains Palestinian journalist and Drop Site contributor Mohamed Awad Israeli forces detained Palestinian journalist and Drop Site contributor Mohamed Awad, 38, from his home in Bitunia, west of Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, early Wednesday morning. Soldiers first raided an apartment in a different neighborhood that Awad's family had moved out of months earlier, breaking down the door only to find it empty, Awda’s wife Eman Awad told Al-Araby. They then went on foot to the family's current home and pounded on the door until Awad opened it. He was blindfolded, handcuffed behind his back, and forced to walk down five flights of stairs before being taken away in a military jeep in a scene captured on video. Awad’s reporting for Drop Site has covered escalating violence by Israeli settlers across the West Bank, including the burning of a mosque in Qusra, south of Nablus, and an attack in Masafer Yatta last week that wounded five Palestinians and burned four homes. With his detention, the number of Palestinian journalists held in Israeli prisons has risen to 40, according to the Palestinian Prisoner's Society.

Kenya has made tremendous strides in many sectors under Vision 2030, launched in 2008 by President Mwai Kibaki. Across the country, we have witnessed the transformation of our infrastructure and the delivery of landmark projects, including the Lamu Port, the Isiolo-Moyale road, and the Nairobi Expressway, among others. These achievements have expanded opportunity, strengthened connectivity and laid a strong foundation for our nation’s future. As Vision 2030 approaches the end of its course, we gathered at Nairobi's Kenyatta International Convention Centre to begin an important national conversation: What comes next? This is not simply a question about another plan or another set of targets. It is an invitation to imagine, together, the Kenya we want to become not only in the next decade, but also deep into the future. The defining character of this new endeavour must be that it is citizen-led and people-centred. It must draw its ambition, ideas and aspirations from the people of Kenya. Government will not prescribe this vision. Instead, it will only play a facilitative role, creating the space, platforms and institutions through which Kenyans can shape the future they desire. Our future must be designed through the collective imagination, wisdom and participation of the citizens - youth, entrepreneurs, farmers, workers, academia, civil society and religious groups, among others.
Joined Kenyans for the National Conversation on Beyond Vision 2030 at the Kenyatta International Convention Centre, Nairobi.

"For the first time, two vaccines specifically designed against #Ebola Bundibugyo virus have now entered phase one safety trials in humans. In addition, two new animal studies of the vaccine against Zaire ebolavirus – the more common species – have shown promising evidence of cross protection in animals. On that basis, WHO has recommended inclusion of the vaccine in a phase three trial, which we hope to start as soon as possible. We do not know whether this vaccine is efficacious against Bundibugyo disease in humans. The phase three trial is the best way to ensure a safe and effective vaccine is available as soon as possible for this and future outbreaks. We call on all partners to support and accelerate this trial. At the same time, we are moving rapidly to generate evidence on treatments. The WHO-sponsored PARTNERS trial has now reached the milestone of 100 patients. This trial demonstrates that, even in the midst of a challenging outbreak, it is possible to mobilize research rapidly and responsibly. None of this work is done by WHO alone, or the government alone, or @AfricaCDC alone. It is all of us, working together as one"-@DrTedros

"Early clinical care and safe and dignified burials are therefore critical for interrupting #Ebola transmission [in the #DRC]. And both depend on the trust of affected communities, which means community engagement and community ownership are essential. There is no other way. So under the leadership of the government, we are now scaling up every part of the response, with the primary goal of interrupting transmission. Surveillance is our priority operational challenge. With partners, we are mapping and pooling resources to strengthen community-based surveillance, to bring every suspected case into care and reach the 95% contact-tracing target needed to interrupt transmission — today we are at around 80%. We are also tripling treatment capacity, with a goal of 3000 beds within 12 weeks. We also need to recruit and train three health workers for every patient. That’s thousands more than we have at the moment. Although we face many challenges, we have also made significant progress. More than 21,000 community health workers have been trained. Treatment centres, safe burial teams, laboratories and community engagement are operating across the affected provinces, reaching hundreds of thousands of people; And 886 patients have recovered, even without specific therapeutics and vaccines, which are progressing in trials"-@DrTedros

"Last week I travelled to the #DRC, where I had the honour of meeting with His Excellency President Félix Tshisekedi, and other leaders and partners. Together we assessed the response to the #Ebola epidemic in the country’s northeast, and how to address the challenges we face. I very much welcome the President’s leadership and commitment to doing everything he can to bring this outbreak under control. It is already the second-biggest Ebola epidemic on record, and it is moving faster than any previous Ebola outbreak. At its current pace, it is on track to eclipse the West African Ebola outbreak of 2014 to 2016. Officially, 4449 confirmed cases have been reported, with 2061 deaths across five provinces and 53 health zones. The outbreak had a big head start, it is still way ahead of us, and we are playing catch-up. About 90% of all cases and 80% of deaths are in the province of Ituri, with sustained transmission in the towns of Bunia, Rwampara, Nizi and Lita. Most concerningly, we see a high proportion of deaths in communities instead of treatment units, outside of known contact lists. That tells us there are chains of transmission we don’t know about, and until we know about – and break – every chain of transmission, we will not stop the outbreak. Most transmission happens when people have late-stage disease and are not in treatment, or when their body is handled after they have died"-@DrTedros

गैरजिम्मेदार कांग्रेस ने न केवल देश की जनता को गुमराह किया है बल्कि लोकतांत्रिक मूल्यों का भी हनन किया है। संसद लोकतंत्र का वह पवित्र मंदिर है जहाँ जनता के मुद्दों पर सार्थक चर्चा से देश की दिशा तय होती है, लेकिन इस बार के मानसून सत्र में गैरजिम्मेदार कांग्रेस ने चर्चा से भाग कर और बार–बार अपना गोलपोस्ट चेंज कर देश की लोकतांत्रिक मर्यादा और गरिमा को ही तार–तार कर दिया। वास्तव में कांग्रेस ने देश की जनता को धोखा दिया है। इस पूरे सत्र में राहुल गांधी और समूचे विपक्ष का रवैया उनकी अराजक मानसिकता और लोकतंत्र-विरोधी सोच को उजागर करता है। पूरा सत्र बीतने को है, पर वे एक भी मुद्दे पर गंभीर चर्चा के लिए तैयार नहीं हुए। पहले उन्होंने युवाओं के विषय पर चर्चा करने की मांग की, और जब सरकार इसके लिए पूरी तरह तैयार हो गई, तो कांग्रेस और इंडी गठबंधन यह कहकर भाग खड़ा हुआ कि उन्हें कोई चर्चा ही नहीं करनी है। सरकार हर विषय पर चर्चा के लिए तैयार थी, लेकिन विपक्ष लगातार जनता के मुद्दों से भागता रहा। आखिर विपक्ष Debate, Discussion और Dialogue से क्यों भाग रहा था? यह साफ तौर पर दिखाता है कि विपक्ष मुद्दों को लेकर न तो संजीदा है और न ही गंभीर। संसद में कई नए सांसदों का यह पहला सत्र था। विपक्ष ने केवल हंगामा करके उन नए सांसदों के सामने हमारे लोकतंत्र की एक बेहद शर्मनाक तस्वीर पेश की है। इनके इस अड़ियल रवैये के कारण देश प्रश्नकाल से भी वंचित रह गया और लोकतंत्र के इस मंदिर में जनता से जुड़े कई अहम मुद्दों पर बात तक नहीं हो सकी। राहुल गांधी जी, भारत में नेता प्रतिपक्ष का पद हमेशा से उच्च संवैधानिक गरिमा रखता आया है। लेकिन आपने बार-बार अमर्यादित भाषा, अहंकार, अपने ढुलमुल और गैरजिम्मेदार रवैये से न सिर्फ इस पद को शर्मसार किया है, बल्कि सदन की मर्यादा और गरिमा में भी भारी गिरावट ला दी है। सच्चाई यह है कि राहुल गांधी, कांग्रेस और इंडी गठबंधन चर्चा से इसलिए भाग रहा था क्योंकि उन्हें पता था कि जब माननीय गृह मंत्री जी संसद में बोलेंगे तो राहुल गांधी और इंडी गठबंधन के सारे झूठ धाराशायी हो जायेंगे। पूरा देश जानता है कि जब माननीय गृह मंत्री जी सदन में तथ्यों के साथ बोलते हैं, तो उनके तर्कों के सामने विपक्ष की बोलती बंद हो जाती है। इसी डर से विपक्ष पूरे सत्र में केवल विषयों को बदलता रहा और चर्चा से भागता रहा।

केले. 3 दिवसांच्या महोत्सवात सुमारे 1000 प्रतिनिधींचा सहभाग पुण्यातील बालेवाडी स्पोर्टस कॉम्प्लेक्स येथे आयोजित करण्यात येणाऱ्या या राष्ट्रीय स्तरावरील युवा संमेलनात देशातील सर्व राज्ये व केंद्रशासित प्रदेशांमधून युवकांचा सहभाग राहणार आहे. प्रत्येक राज्य व केंद्रशासित प्रदेशातून सुमारे 30 ते 35 प्रतिनिधी सहभागी होण्याचे नियोजन असून एकूण सुमारे 1000 प्रतिनिधी सहभागी होतील. यामध्ये महाराष्ट्राचे 300 प्रतिनिधी, तर इतर राज्ये व केंद्रशासित प्रदेशांमधून 700 प्रतिनिधी सहभागी होतील. 3 दिवसांच्या या महोत्सवाला राज्यभरातील 1 लाखांहून अधिक युवकांचा प्रतिसाद मिळण्यासाठी योग्य नियोजन करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, विकसित भारत युथ कॉन्क्लेव्ह-2026 हा भारताच्या युवा शक्तीला क्रीडा, नवोन्मेष आणि संस्कृतीच्या माध्यमातून एकत्र आणणारा राष्ट्रीय स्तरावरील उपक्रम म्हणून प्रस्तावित आहे. यातून युवकांमध्ये नेतृत्वगुण विकसित करणे, नवोन्मेष व उद्योजकतेला चालना देणे, देशाची सांस्कृतिक विविधता साजरी करणे, आरोग्यपूर्ण जीवनशैलीला प्रोत्साहन देणे आणि राष्ट्रीय एकात्मता दृढ करणे, ही या उपक्रमाची प्रमुख उद्दिष्टे आहेत. या युवा संमेलनाची संकल्पना वॉरिअर, फ्युचर आणि कल्चरल असा 3 अनुभव क्षेत्रांमध्ये करण्यात यावी, या तिन्ही क्षेत्रांमधून युवकांना क्रीडा, अनुभवाधारित उपक्रमही यात असावेत, असेही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. पुणे हे तंत्रज्ञान आणि नवोन्मेषाचे महत्त्वाचे केंद्र असल्याने 'फ्युचर झोन'मध्ये युवकांच्या तंत्रज्ञानविषयक क्षमतांना प्रोत्साहन द्यावे. 'कल्चरल झोन'मध्ये सर्जनशीलता, आरोग्यपूर्ण जीवनशैली आणि महाराष्ट्राच्या सांस्कृतिक वारशाचा सुंदर समन्वय साधला जावा. महाराष्ट्रातील लोककला, लोकसंगीत, लोकनृत्य, चित्रकला, छायाचित्रण आदी कलाप्रकारांसाठी स्पर्धा आणि उपक्रम आयोजित करावेत. त्याचबरोबर, योग, ध्यान, मानसिक आरोग्य, श्वसनाचे व्यायाम यांसारख्या उपक्रमांसोबतच स्थानिक हस्तकला, वारली व पैठणी कला, महाराष्ट्रीय पारंपरिक खाद्यसंस्कृती आणि शाश्वत जीवनशैली यांचीही माहिती युवकांना करून देण्यात यावी. या महोत्सवासाठी पूर्णपणे डिजिटल नोंदणी विकसित करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. ऑनलाइन नोंदणी, राज्यनिहाय नामनिर्देशन, कागदपत्र पडताळणी, क्युआर कोड आधारित डिजिटल ओळखपत्र, मोबाईल कार्यक्रम मार्गदर्शक आणि थेट सूचना अशी डिजिटल सुविधा उपलब्ध करून देण्यात यावी. त्यामुळे सहभागी युवकांची नोंदणी, प्रवेश आणि विविध उपक्रमांतील सहभाग याचे प्रभावी व्यवस्थापन करता येईल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. क्रीडा क्षेत्रात खासगी सहभाग वाढविण्यावर भर 'खेलो इंडिया'अंतर्गत केंद्र शासनाकडून मोठ्या प्रमाणावर निधी उपलब्ध होणार असल्याने महाराष्ट्राने केंद्राच्या योजनांमध्ये प्रभावी सहभाग घेण्याबरोबरच क्रीडा क्षेत्रात खासगी क्षेत्राची गुंतवणूक आणि सार्वजनिक-खासगी भागीदारीवर भर देण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. तसेच पायाभूत क्रीडा सुविधा विकसित करण्यासाठी कॉर्पोरेट क्षेत्रातील क्रीडा फाउंडेशनशी समन्वय साधण्याच्या सूचना दिल्या. आगामी दशकात महाराष्ट्राला क्रीडा क्षेत्रात आघाडीवर नेण्यासाठी शासकीय प्रयत्नांसोबतच खासगी क्षेत्राची भागीदारी आवश्यक असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री एकनाथ शिंदे, उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @mieknathshinde @SunetraA_Pawar #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #SportsDepartment

According to the New York Times, the threat in Ankara was considered serious enough for the Secret Service to secretly move Trump off Air Force One in a catering container and onto another military aircraft. Air Force One then departed for Britain with senior officials, military personnel and journalists aboard, while those passengers were apparently unaware that the presidential aircraft itself was considered at risk. The operation was intended to conceal Trump's movements and prevent an adversary from knowing which aircraft he was actually aboard. The unusual aspect is that the deception potentially shifted the risk from the president to other passengers without their knowledge. The article also notes that this differs from previous presidential deception operations. During Bill Clinton's 1999/2000 Pakistan trip, for example, journalists were at least partially informed of the deception, and the details were publicly disclosed after the president was safe. The White House has defended the decision, with Trump saying he followed Secret Service advice. Former officials interviewed by the NYT are divided: some argue that protecting the president necessarily takes precedence, while others contend that knowingly placing uninformed civilians in a potentially targeted aircraft crosses an important line.

বিশ্বকাপের মতোই মহাদেশীয় টুর্নামেন্ট কোপা আমেরিকা অনুষ্ঠিত হতো চার বছর পর পর। কিন্তু ২০১৫ সাল থেকে বদলে যায় সেই নিয়ম। ২০১৫ থেকে ২০২৪ সাল— এই নয় বছরে কোপা আমেরিকা অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে মোট পাঁচবার। তবে ২০২৮ সাল থেকে এই টুর্নামেন্ট ফিরছে আগের নিয়মে। অর্থাৎ, ২০২৮ সাল থেকে আবারও চার বছর পর পর অনুষ্ঠিত হবে এই টুর্নামেন্ট। কোপা আমেরিকার প্রথম আসর অনুষ্ঠিত হয় ১৯৭৫ সালে। সেবার কলম্বিয়াকে হারিয়ে প্রথম আসরেই শিরোপা জেতে পেরু। এরপর বিশ্বকাপের মতো চার বছর পর পর অনুষ্ঠিত হতো এই টুর্নামেন্ট। যেখানে সবচেয়ে বেশিবার শিরোপা ঘরে তুলেছে আর্জেন্টিনা। ২০১৫ সালের পর ২০১৬ সালেই আবার মাঠে গড়ায় কোপা আমেরিকার আসর। এই দুই আসরেই আর্জেন্টিনাকে হারিয়ে চ্যাম্পিয়ন হয় চিলি। তার তিন বছর পর আবারও মাঠে গড়ায় এই টুর্নামেন্ট। সেবার আর্জেন্টিনা বাদ পড়ে যায় আগেই। ফাইনালে পেরুকে হারিয়ে শিরোপা জেতে ব্রাজিল। এরপর ২০২১ ও ২০২৪ সালে টানা দুবার শিরোপা ঘরে তোলে আর্জেন্টিনা। এই টুর্নামেন্টে সবচেয়ে বেশিবার (৩০ বার) ফাইনাল খেলেছে আলবিসেলেস্তেরা। তার মধ্যে সবচেয়ে বেশি মোট ১৬ বার চ্যাম্পিয়ন হয়েছে তারা। এরপর ১৫টি শিরোপা ঘরে তুলেছে উরুগুয়ে, তারা ফাইনাল খেলেছে মোট ২১টি। এ তালিকায় তিন নম্বরে আছে ব্রাজিল। ২০ বার ফাইনাল মাত্র ৯টি শিরোপা জিতেছে সেলেসাওরা। এছাড়া প্যারাগুয়ে ৮ বার, চিলি ৬ বার, পেরু ও কলম্বিয়া ৩ বার করে এবং বলিভিয়া ও মেক্সিকো চ্যাম্পিয়ন হয়েছে ২ বার করে।

गैरजिम्मेदार कांग्रेस ने पुरे विपक्ष को मुद्दे से भटकाया। संसद लोकतंत्र का वह पवित्र मंदिर है जहाँ जनता के मुद्दों पर सार्थक चर्चा से देश की दिशा तय होती है, लेकिन इस बार के मानसून सत्र में गैरजिम्मेदार कांग्रेस ने पूरे विपक्ष को मुद्दों से भटकाने का ही काम किया है, उनको गुमराह किया है। इस पूरे सत्र में राहुल गांधी और समूचे विपक्ष का रवैया उनकी अराजक मानसिकता और लोकतंत्र-विरोधी सोच को उजागर करता है। पूरा सत्र बीतने को है, पर वे एक भी मुद्दे पर गंभीर चर्चा के लिए तैयार नहीं हुए। पहले उन्होंने युवाओं के विषय पर चर्चा करने की मांग की, और जब मोदी सरकार इसके लिए पूरी तरह तैयार हो गई, तो विपक्ष यह कहकर भाग खड़ा हुआ कि उन्हें कोई चर्चा ही नहीं करनी है। सरकार हर विषय पर चर्चा के लिए तैयार थी, लेकिन विपक्ष लगातार जनता के मुद्दों से भागता रहा। आखिर विपक्ष Debate, Discussion और Dialogue से क्यों भाग रहा था? यह साफ तौर पर दिखाता है कि विपक्ष मुद्दों को लेकर न तो संजीदा है और न ही गंभीर। संसद में कई नए सांसदों का यह पहला सत्र था। विपक्ष ने केवल हंगामा करके उन नए सांसदों के सामने हमारे लोकतंत्र की एक बेहद शर्मनाक तस्वीर पेश की है। इनके इस अड़ियल रवैये के कारण देश प्रश्नकाल से भी वंचित रह गया और लोकतंत्र के इस मंदिर में जनता से जुड़े कई अहम मुद्दों पर बात तक नहीं हो सकी। राहुल गांधी जी, भारत में नेता प्रतिपक्ष का पद हमेशा से उच्च संवैधानिक गरिमा रखता आया है। लेकिन आपने बार-बार अमर्यादित भाषा, अहंकार, अपने ढुलमुल और गैरजिम्मेदार रवैये से न सिर्फ इस पद को शर्मसार किया है, बल्कि सदन की मर्यादा और गरिमा में भी भारी गिरावट ला दी है। सच्चाई यह है कि विपक्ष चर्चा से इसलिए भाग रहा था क्योंकि वे माननीय गृह मंत्री जी का सामना करने से डरते हैं। गृह मंत्री जी ने सड़क से सदन तक का एक लंबा राजनैतिक सफर तय किया है और पूरा देश जानता है कि जब वे सदन में तथ्यों के साथ बोलते हैं, तो उनके तर्कों के सामने विपक्ष की बोलती बंद हो जाती है। इसी डर से विपक्ष पूरे सत्र में केवल विषयों को बदलता रहा और चर्चा से भागता रहा।

Shri Ashok Kumar Lahiri, Vice Chairman, NITI Aayog, along with Shri Ishtiyaque Ahmed, Programme Director, visited Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS), New Delhi, to review advanced dental machinery, technologies and emerging capabilities in the sector. The visit provided an opportunity to deliberate on key challenges and opportunities shaping India’s dental technology ecosystem, with discussions focusing on import dependence, patents and licensing, technology access, and the need to accelerate indigenous R&D, innovation and manufacturing of dental equipment. The emphasis was on creating a stronger bridge between research, technology development and domestic manufacturing—reducing dependence on imports while fostering globally competitive, homegrown solutions for India’s healthcare needs. 🇮🇳 Bringing the Colours of Madhubani, Bihar to Abuja 🇳🇬 From India to Abuja, the vibrant colours and intricate patterns of Madhubani painting from the state of Bihar came alive! 🇮🇳🎨✨ As part of the 80th Independence Day celebrations, the High Commission of India, Abuja hosted a Madhubani Painting Workshop for members of the Indian community, organised by the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) in collaboration with Routes2Roots. "The jade dragon of Hongshan culture marks another round of long-distance prehistoric jade diffusion in China, following the southward spread of Northeast Asian jue rings." At the 2026 Conference on Hongshan Culture, Fang Xiangming, director and research fellow at the Zhejiang Provincial Institute of Cultural Relics and Archaeology, shared his research on the spread and evolution of the Hongshan jade dragon. He stated that the Hongshan jade dragon spread over 1,500 kilometers to the lower Yangtze region, eventually becoming part of the deity figure, the unified emblem of Liangzhu belief. Reaching 1,500 kilometers away to the Taihu Lake Basin, this transmission spread three-dimensional carving techniques and beliefs. Beyond borrowing artistic motifs and forms, it reflects a shared mythological belief. The Hongshan and Liangzhu cultures are the earliest and most systematic models in the heritage and innovation of Chinese jade culture, forming essential pillars of China's 5,000-year civilization. #HongshanCulture #CulturalJourney Video

Video ANI (@ANI) #WATCH | Pune, Maharashtra: A passenger from SpiceJet flight SG 105 from Delhi to Pune on August 11, Leshpal, says, "...Our SpiceJet flight was scheduled for 9.55, but it was delayed. Boarding began at 10.30, and we boarded the flight then. About half an hour passed; there was no ventilation inside, we were facing difficulty breathing, and the AC wasn't running. Since I am not a regular flyer, I assumed it was just a technical issue. Later, the situation escalated to the point where our clothes were completely soaked with sweat; every passenger was in the same state. Children were crying, pregnant women were having difficulties... We staged a protest right there on the tarmac because the staff was not cooperating and snapping back at us for causing a scene. Eventually, their technical team arrived and conducted a check; even their own team confirmed, "There is an issue; the plane cannot fly"... Later, they took us back inside, arranged another flight for 5:00 AM, and we finally departed at that time. They had taken us out to the runway, and we kept urging them to check the plane..." Od 17 sierpnia Polacy korzystający ze Starlink Roam mają być traktowani gorzej niż klienci z innych państw Europy: dodatkowe formalności, obowiązek zgłaszania podróży i weryfikacja dokumentów. Polscy obywatele nie mogą być traktowani gorzej tylko dlatego, że globalna korporacja tak zdecydowała. Nowe technologie dają ludziom ogromne możliwości. Ale wraz z nimi globalne firmy zdobyły ogromną władzę nad warunkami, na jakich pracujemy, komunikujemy się, podróżujemy i korzystamy z usług. অস্ট্রেলিয়ার বিপক্ষে দুই ম্যাচের টেস্ট সিরিজ দিয়ে দীর্ঘ অপেক্ষার অবসান ঘটাতে যাচ্ছে বাংলাদেশ।বৃহস্পতিবার (১৩ আগস্ট) ডারউইনের মারারা স্টেডিয়ামে শুরু হবে সিরিজের প্রথম টেস্ট। বিশ্ব টেস্ট চ্যাম্পিয়নশিপের অংশ হওয়ায় ম্যাচ পরিচালনার দায়িত্বে থাকছেন আইসিসির অভিজ্ঞ ও শীর্ষস্থানীয় ম্যাচ অফিসিয়ালরা। প্রথম টেস্টে অন-ফিল্ড আম্পায়ারের দায়িত্বে থাকবেন ইংল্যান্ডের রিচার্ড ইলিংওর্থ ও শ্রীলঙ্কার কুমার ধর্মসেনা। তৃতীয় আম্পায়ার হিসেবে থাকবেন ভারতের নীতিন মেনন। চতুর্থ আম্পায়ারের দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন অস্ট্রেলিয়ার স্যাম নোগাজস্কি। ম্যাচ রেফারি হিসেবে থাকবেন রিচার্ড রিচার্ডসন। ২২ আগস্ট ম্যাকাইয়ের গ্রেট ব্যারিয়ার রিফ এরেনায় শুরু হবে সিরিজের দ্বিতীয় ও শেষ টেস্ট। সেখানে অন-ফিল্ড আম্পায়ার হিসেবে দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন নীতিন মেনন ও কুমার ধর্মসেনা। তৃতীয় আম্পায়ার থাকবেন ইলিংওর্থ এবং চতুর্থ আম্পায়ার দোনোভান কচ। ম্যাচ রেফারি হিসেবে থাকবেন রিচার্ডসনই। ২০০৩ সালের পর এবারই প্রথম অস্ট্রেলিয়ার মাটিতে টেস্ট খেলবে বাংলাদেশ। প্রস্তুতি ম্যাচে ক্রিকেট অস্ট্রেলিয়া একাদশের কাছে ইনিংস ব্যবধানে হারায় সফরকারীদের আত্মবিশ্বাসে কিছুটা ধাক্কা লেগেছে। অন্যদিকে, বিশ্ব টেস্ট চ্যাম্পিয়নশিপের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পয়েন্ট হাতছাড়া করতে না চেয়ে পূর্ণ শক্তির দল নিয়ে মাঠে নামছে অস্ট্রেলিয়া। #cricket #cricketnews #NewsUpdate #somoytv

V inspiring … Ajai Chowdhry (@AjaiChowdhry) We quit our jobs. There were six of us — Shiv Nadar, Arjun Malhotra, Yogesh Vaidya, Subhash Arora, D.S. Puri and me. It was 1976. Startups were not really a thing in India. Venture capital did not exist. Banks were not exactly lining up to lend money to six young men with an idea and no collateral. And computers? Most people had barely heard of them. But we believed the microprocessor was going to change the world. So we took the plunge. Between the six of us, we managed to put together ₹1.87 lakh. We borrowed, pooled our savings and, in one case, even sold a car. Our first office was a small barsati in Golf Links, Delhi. We called ourselves Microcomp. We wanted to build an Indian computer. There was just one problem. We didn’t have a manufacturing licence. That eventually led us to UP Electronics Corporation. They had the licence. We had the technology. And that partnership gave birth to Hindustan Computers Limited — HCL. But perhaps the most audacious part of the story was what happened next. We started selling a computer that was still being designed. We had a brochure and a mock-up of the machine. That was it. Our sales teams went across India, knocking on doors and convincing businesses to buy into a technology they had never used before. The first orders came from IIT Kharagpur and IIT Madras. Then came the harder part — convincing businesses. In Coimbatore, we were up against DCM DP, a much bigger and more established name. I still remember sitting in the reception area of Premier Mills while the DCM team made its pitch. We went in second. And we won. That one order gave us five more. Then ten. That was HCL in those early years: not having the biggest balance sheet, the biggest brand or the easiest path — but finding a way. We were restless. We looked for gaps. We hired people who had what we called a “cowboy” spirit. We believed that technology had to be made useful and accessible, not intimidating. And we kept moving. From building India’s early indigenous computers to taking our business to Singapore when HCL was just four years old. From a small room in Delhi to a global technology company. When I look back at 50 years, I think about six people sitting together in 1976, wondering if this crazy idea could actually work. I think about a barsati. A brochure for a computer that did not yet exist. And the courage to knock on the next door. That, to me, is the real HCL story. 50 years later, the technology has changed beyond anything we could have imagined. But the spirit remains the same: Dream big. Take the risk. And above all, Just Aspire. Happy 50th, HCL. I was highly skeptical of the very enthusiastic and open support for #Yabloko in the upcoming Duma elections from virtually all the Russian opposition in exile. First of all, “elections” is far too strong a word for this process. Secondly, there is no doubt that only the Presidential Administration decides who appears on the ballot. Yabloko’s participation therefore served a clear purpose in the eyes of Russian political managers. Simulation of normality. Thirdly, there was never any question that Yabloko was not aiming for a “revolution in the Duma.” It was simply trying to secure its continued niche while accepting the overall rules of the game. Yesterday a court barred them from the elections altogether. Now many voices are “blaming” the Russian opposition in exile for supporting Yabloko too openly and thereby provoking an angry reaction inside Russia. It turns out (see the link for detailed @RiddleRussia on this in the first comment) that it was not the émigrés who made the difference, but Russians inside Russia itself. The moment Yabloko stepped out of the shadows and announced it would participate in the elections under anti-war slogans, interest among Russians surged surpassing the ruling United Russia figure despite heavy paid promotion of United Russia on all platforms. This does not mean Yabloko would have won a majority in free and fair elections just like that. But running on a simple “stop the war” platform would almost certainly have let them aim for second place with relatively little effort. Based on this promise alone. The Presidential Administration simply did not anticipate such a sharp surge of interest—or the potential catastrophe it posed for their carefully staged “nice results.” Upsetting Putin is too much of a risk. That is why Yabloko was banned.

Lorna Kapunan na malaman kung kaninong AOMs ang ipriprisenta ni Ferrer dahil aniya, "the defendant's documents were not identified nor presented to the witness." Dagdag ni Kapunan, "if counsel wants to confront the witness with documents she has identified, she has to use the prosecution's evidence because that was the one identified by the witness." Tugon ni Ferrer, "[the prosecution's] AOM, we did not dispute those. So we have the same copy, Your Honor." Iginiit naman ni Kapunan na gamitin ni Ferrer ang kopya ng prosekusyon, na patuloy na tinutuligsa ng depensa. Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif's Message on International Youth Day 12 August 2026. Pakistan joins the international community in observing International Youth Day and pays tribute to our talented youth for their immense potential, vibrant energy, and positive aspirations. This year, International Youth Day is being observed under the theme “Different Contexts, Common Aspirations.” The theme duly underscores the fact that although the lives of young people across the world are shaped by diverse circumstances, their dreams, aspirations, and hopes for a brighter future remain remarkably similar. Our youth are an invaluable National asset and are the promising driving force for our bright future. The creativity and determined efforts of our young people are undoubtedly contributing to encouraging progress across every sector of society. Harnessing the potential and capabilities of our youth is essential for building a prosperous, peaceful, and strong Pakistan. Pakistan’s young population has brought laurels to the country at both the national and international levels through their achievements across various fields of life. At the local level too, our youth are playing a constructive role as active members of society. Ensuring the best possible intellectual, physical, mental, and academic development of our youth through the effective utilization of all available national resources remains among the Government’s key priorities. The Government of Pakistan is committed to empowering our youth through modern and quality education aligned with the demands of the day, through dedicated efforts to promote technical and vocational skills, employment opportunities, entrepreneurship, industrial development, digital innovation, and social inclusion. Alongside various policy initiatives, the Government is also taking practical measures enabling young people to align their abilities, skills, and professional competencies with international standards so to make the country proud on the global stage. To provide talented students with opportunities to advance in education, information technology, technical fields, and artificial intelligence, the Government has taken several important initiatives, including scholarship programmes, laptop distribution, and paid internships for students. Furthermore, the Prime Minister’s Youth Skill Development Programme (PMYSDP) is striving to ensure a talented and skilled workforce in the country. The National Vocational and Technical Training Commission (NAVTTC) has been further strengthened on a priority basis to provide internationally recognized certifications and world-class training in professional and technical skills.The national institution is taking special measures to equip the workforce with internationally recognized qualifications and the skills required by industries. On this day, I have a special message for our youth: continue your journey of hard work with honesty, responsibility, and a spirit of service to the nation. The sustainable development and bright future of our country are intrinsically linked to the progress of our youth. Let us renew our resolve to work together with full commitment and play a constructive and active role in the development and prosperity of our country, so that our homeland becomes a guarantee of a bright future for all segments of society especially our youth.

Prof. K.V. Raju, Member, NITI Aayog, along with officials from NITI Aayog, visited Telangana from 05–07 August 2026 to engage with the State Government on key development priorities. During the visit, Prof. Raju held discussions with the Chief Secretary and senior officials of the State Government. He emphasised the need for adopting a uniform methodology for estimating District Domestic Product (DDP) and Primary Sector GDP to enable consistent assessment and support evidence-based decision-making at the district level. Detailed deliberations were also held on advancing the State’s implementation strategy for achieving the objectives outlined in the Vision Document and establishing an institutional mechanism for regular review of progress and resolution of implementation challenges. Prof. Raju also visited sites showcasing some of Telangana’s best practices, including initiatives under the National Mission on Edible Oils – Oil Palm (NMEO-OP), innovative horticulture farming practices, and the development of Genome Valley as a leading biotechnology and life sciences hub in India. The visit further strengthened the partnership between NITI Aayog and the Government of Telangana and reaffirmed the shared commitment to translating the State’s development priorities into a strategic roadmap towards the goals of Viksit Bharat by 2047. #Telangana #CooperativeFederalism @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Many vessels are hugging Oman’s coastline and receiving U.S. military assistance, allowing millions of barrels per day to leave the Persian Gulf and helping contain oil prices. Brent crude traded above $90 on Tuesday, before settling at $88.91 per barrel. But few tankers are entering to replace those leaving. ADNOC says 15 of its vessels have been attacked during the war. The limited number of shipowners willing to enter the Gulf has pushed benchmark tanker earnings close to $500,000 per day and ADNOC’s shipping arm reported sharply higher quarterly earnings from elevated freight rates and additional export services. Analyst Brett Erickson told Drop Site that outbound vessels are outnumbering inbound vessels by roughly 3.5 to one. That means the system is drawing down the finite pool of tankers already inside the Gulf. Bloomberg said satellite imagery captured 12 ship-to-ship transfers off Oman and the UAE on Monday, indicating that tankers continue crossing with their tracking systems disabled. At least 4 outbound supertankers (VLCCs) carrying a combined 8 million barrels of crude have reappeared after transiting Hormuz since Saturday. Many vessels are hugging Oman’s coastline and receiving U.S. military assistance, allowing millions of barrels per day to leave the Persian Gulf and helping contain oil prices. Brent crude traded above $90 on Tuesday, before settling at $88.91 per barrel. But few tankers are entering to replace those leaving. ADNOC says 15 of its vessels have been attacked during the war. The limited number of shipowners willing to enter the Gulf has pushed benchmark tanker earnings close to $500,000 per day and ADNOC’s shipping arm reported sharply higher quarterly earnings from elevated freight rates and additional export services. Analyst Brett Erickson told Drop Site that outbound vessels are outnumbering inbound vessels by roughly 3.5 to one. That means the system is drawing down the finite pool of tankers already inside the Gulf. Without enough empty ships returning, he believes the storage will fill, causing production to be shut in, and making current export levels to become impossible to sustain. “This is buying time,” Erickson said. @ryangrim | @BrettErickson28 | @MazMHussain Video

Israel is entering a new “robotic age” in warfare, accelerating lessons learned from Gaza and Lebanon, where tens of thousands of unmanned and remotely operated systems have already been deployed. Under the IDF’s 2026 to 2030 Hoshen Plan, robotics, AI and autonomous systems will become central to force building across land, air and sea. The IDF is also establishing dedicated structures for robotics and autonomous warfare. Over the next decade, Israel plans to expand robotic systems for tunnel operations, reconnaissance, logistics, route clearance and combat. Older armored vehicles are also being converted into remotely operated platforms, while drone and ground robot swarms are being developed. The longer term goal is mixed human machine formations, with robotic systems moving ahead of soldiers and taking on the most dangerous battlefield missions while humans retain oversight of lethal decisions.

China Begins Shipping Goods to Europe via the Northern Sea Route Important news for global trade: China is launching the first regular container route through the Arctic waters of the Northern Sea Route. In recent years, the melting ice has made such shipments very promising. It is expected that ships from China will reach Europe in just 20 days, compared to 40 days via the southern route through the Suez Canal. Furthermore, this traditional route is not entirely safe today. What are the benefits for us? First, Russia, thanks to its geographical location and the world's most powerful icebreaker fleet, is the only country capable of ensuring the passage of maritime convoys along the NSR. Therefore, it has every right to charge for transit. The funds raised can be used to develop the Russian Arctic region, including military facilities for its defense. Many experts predict that in the near future, there will be competition between Russia and other Arctic states for the region's resources. We need to prepare for this struggle in advance. Second, the Northern Sea Route is the shortest and safest trade route between Russia and its largest trading partner, China, as well as with other countries in the region that maintain economic ties with Moscow. For European companies engaging in maritime piracy, our ships in the Arctic remain inaccessible. Again, this is because we have many icebreakers, while they have very few. And it's also a bit scary to engage in piracy under the sights of Russian "Bal" and "Bastion" systems. Third, the launch of regular commercial shipments enhances the prestige of Russia and China, which are visibly creating an alternative to the long-established logistics of international maritime trade. This is an element of the multipolar world that Vladimir Putin has spoken about repeatedly. Want to transport goods from Europe to Asia faster? Pay a visit to Moscow and Beijing. And they will take it from there. Of course, we shouldn't get ahead of ourselves. The NSR remains a seasonal and technically challenging route. If the ice conditions, insurance costs, sanctions, and the cost of icebreaker escort turn out to be higher than expected, carriers will use it as a niche or crisis route, rather than as a full-fledged alternative to the Suez Canal. Therefore, there is still a lot of work to be done to unlock the full potential of the Northern Sea Route. @sashakots

Daily Ukraine map thread for Tuesday 11th August 2026 A full focus today on the Lyman to Kupiansk front along the Kharkiv/Luhansk border, where, remarkably, both sides remain broadly matched and the map has displayed all the dynamism of a particularly stubborn brick wall. Much has been made of the 3rd Army Corps’ OPSEC north of Lyman, accompanied by the usual imaginative reporting about vast offensives which, like most vast offensives announced on Telegram, appear to exist primarily in the imagination. The relative silence tells rather more. Ukraine has achieved a partial success in relieving pressure around Lyman, where Russian infiltrators had previously managed to make things distinctly uncomfortable. But the other half of the job - actually cutting the salient - has not happened yet. And we should remember just how slowly this particular war moves. This sector has been in "quiet mode" for months. The area in question is sufficiently compact that a reasonably determined man could walk across much of it in about three hours, assuming he wasn't being shot at, which does rather spoil a nice walk. Yet after months, there is still no meaningful encirclement. At this pace, you simply aren't cutting off significant numbers of troops. You are giving them plenty of time to wander away, bring their belongings, and probably leave a forwarding address. That doesn't mean the Ukrainian effort has been pointless. Ukrainian losses appear to have remained relatively low, some ground has been recovered, Russian pressure around Lyman has been reduced, and perhaps most importantly, the Ukrainians have gained valuable experience conducting offensive operations. That last point matters enormously. Offensive experience is precisely the sort of thing Ukrainian forces have been painfully short of, and unlike territory, it cannot be measured neatly on a map. Further north, however, Russia has spent the year consolidating its positions. Russian forces are once again operating in Kupiansk and Kupiansk Vuzlovyi. For the moment, this isn't necessarily catastrophic. But it creates the ingredients for another attempt at taking the city. And this time, Russia may have learned from its previous performance. Last year, Russian forces appeared rather keen to declare premature victory in Kupiansk, at which point the Ukrainians enthusiastically demonstrated the disadvantages of premature celebration by killing a considerable number of them and clearing the city. This time the Russians hold additional positions on the eastern side of the Oskil, giving them a much better platform from which to infiltrate and pressure the city. So, for now, the Lyman to Kupiansk sector remains a curious combination of tactical activity and strategic inertia. In other words, after months of fighting over an area you could cross on foot in an afternoon, everyone remains remarkably close to where they started.
